# UltraPixel

> UltraPixel is a manufacturer of premium and technical self-adhesive labels based in Trieste, Italy, serving brands across Europe.

UltraPixel Srl (VAT IT01240410322) was founded in 2013. It designs, prints and finishes self-adhesive labels in Trieste, Italy, for brands, wineries, manufacturers, agents and distributors in Italy and across Europe.

## Company facts

- UltraPixel Srl: Via J. Ressel 3, 34018 San Dorligo della Valle (TS), Italy
- UltraPixel France: 11 Rue Pouteau, 69001 Lyon, France
- Email: info@ultrapixel.it
- Phone: +39 040 817222
- Website languages: Italiano, English, Français, Deutsch

## Sectors

- [Wine & Spirits labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/wine-spirits/) / [Wine & Spirits labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/wine-spirits/): Premium papers, foil, embossing and tactile effects, with materials selected for ice buckets and complex finishing in register.
- [Food labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/food-labels/) / [Food labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/food-labels/): Labels for industrial production and automatic application, with materials and adhesives selected for cold, humidity and contact with oils.
- [Cosmetics & Nutraceuticals labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/cosmetics-nutraceuticals/) / [Cosmetics & Nutraceuticals labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/cosmetics-nutraceuticals/): Premium decoration on transparent and special materials, with opaque whites, tactile effects and small batches.
- [Pharma labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/pharma-labels/) / [Pharma labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/pharma-labels/): Labels printed for precision and readability, with solutions for variable data, traceability and consistency between runs.
- [Industrial & Chemical labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/industrial-chemical/) / [Industrial & Chemical labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/industrial-chemical/): Technical materials and adhesives selected for difficult surfaces and demanding conditions, with variable data, QR codes and traceability.

## Technologies

Digital printing, Hot foil, Screen printing, Embossing, Debossing, High-build tactile effects, Microtextures, Die-cutting, Reverse printing, Multilayer / booklet labels, Variable data, Numbering, Lamination, Colour measurement and control.
